name: School of War
description: Play the School of War if you want to utilize trained magic for violence.

foundation.name: Battlemage
foundation.text: You’ve focused your studies on becoming an unconquerable force on the battlefield. Gain an additional Hit Point slot.

foundation.name: Face Your Fear
foundation.text: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, you deal an extra 1d10 magic damage.

specialization.name: Conjure Shield
specialization.text: You can maintain a protective barrier of magic. While you have at least 2 Hope, you add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

specialization.name: Fueled by Fear
specialization.text: The extra magic damage from your “Face Your Fear” feature increases to 2d10.

mastery.name: Thrive in Chaos
mastery.text: When you succeed on an attack, you can mark a Stress after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

mastery.name: Have No Fear
mastery.text: The extra magic damage from your “Face Your Fear” feature increases to 3d10.
